summary: Abrupt spectral flux jump detected at 7400 ms
explanation: Short-time Fourier transform (STFT) shows an abrupt shift in background noise floor and phase discontinuity at t=7400 ms across frequencies 500 Hz to 4 kHz.
alternative_explanation: The speaker or microphone may have bumped the podium or experienced momentary wireless drop/cellular interference, or a camera angle edit occurred in the source recording.
limitations: Spectral flux shifts cannot distinguish between physical recording pauses, hardware buffer underruns, and deliberate audio splice edits without reference master audio.

summary: Normal video scene cut detected at 7400 ms
explanation: Frame-to-frame color histogram delta indicates a standard camera angle cut from podium close-up to wide quad perspective at t=7400 ms (frame 222).
alternative_explanation: Standard multi-camera video editing or mobile pause-and-resume.
limitations: Scene cuts are standard editing conventions and do not indicate manipulation on their own.

summary: Clustered identical keypoint groups detected in crowd section
explanation: SIFT keypoint descriptor matching identified two dense clusters of matching feature points (n=84) with identical spatial offsets in the upper-right audience sector.
alternative_explanation: Repetitive physical background patterns such as identical promotional banners, uniform student apparel, or tiled architectural facades can generate matching keypoints naturally.
limitations: High-contrast repetitive textures and geometric tiling frequently generate false positive SIFT clusters. Manual visual inspection of pixel noise is required.

summary: Caption attendance figure (3,000) sharply conflicts with spoken speech transcript ('about three hundred')
explanation: Factual quantity extraction parsed 3,000 attendees from social post caption, whereas Whisper speech transcription at t=5200-6800 ms parsed 'about three hundred attendees gathered here today'.
alternative_explanation: Typographical error by social media administrator adding an extra zero, or early preliminary estimate versus actual seated headcount.
limitations: Textual extraction cannot verify ground-truth attendance independently without badge scan logs or gate turnstile records.
